questions.q: What is a Connected App in Salesforce?
options: A type of report
A synonym for a permission set group
A mobile-only version of the Salesforce app
The framework/registration record that lets an external application integrate with Salesforce via SAML, OAuth, or OIDC
questions.explain: A Connected App is the Salesforce-side object that makes SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect integrations concrete and controllable — every external integration using these protocols typically needs one configured.

questions.q: Where do you go in Setup to create a new Connected App?
options: App Manager, then New Connected App
Single Sign-On Settings
Login IP Ranges
Session Settings
questions.explain: From Setup, Quick Find 'App Manager', then click New Connected App to begin registering the integration.

questions.q: What is the Consumer Secret, and how should it be handled?
options: A field only used for SAML, never OAuth
A public identifier safe to post anywhere, like the Consumer Key
A credential that must be protected like a password, since a leak lets an attacker impersonate the connected app
A value that automatically expires after 24 hours and needs no protection
questions.explain: The Consumer Secret is the OAuth client_secret. If leaked, it lets an attacker impersonate the entire connected app for flows that rely on it, which is why it belongs in a secrets manager, never in source control or chat.

questions.q: What does setting the Permitted Users policy to 'Admin approved users are pre-authorized' accomplish?
options: It disables OAuth entirely for the app
It automatically rotates the Consumer Secret daily
It deletes the connected app after one use
It restricts use of the app to users explicitly granted access via profile or permission set, rather than letting anyone self-authorize
questions.explain: This policy requires an admin to explicitly grant access (via profile or permission set assignment) before a user can use the connected app, instead of allowing any user to self-authorize on first use.

questions.q: What must the Callback URL on a connected app match?
options: The redirect URI the external application sends during the OAuth flow
The org's My Domain name
The SAML Issuer value
The user's email domain
questions.explain: The Callback URL must exactly match the redirect URI the external app sends — it's the OAuth equivalent of the SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL.
